rules: Never attempt to obtain material identified as private, restricted, or not open to the public.
Treat catalog URLs as unverified locators until a later authorized job records retrieval outcome, final locator, rights or license, integrity, and content classification.
Do not make linked or described-only material a required dependency before it is retrieved and validated by the worker harness.
Keep later material additions attributable to their source record and do not infer an official course sequence from catalog record order.
Use an original, self-contained substitute when restricted course work is unavailable, and label it as manager-authored.
retrieval_policy.future_expansion_gate: A later job may add units only after material-level availability and official-unit status are independently established.
